note: One indoor scene shared by the fast models and CRANE. Coordinates in metres, x east, y north, origin at the south-west inside corner. All geometry provisional. A run is identified as <scenario_id>/<variant>/<seed>.

walls.note: splits the loading hall (west) from the delivery bay (east); the doorway is the only passage

loading_area.note: payload appears here, behind the shelf as seen from the start

assembly_staging.note: where rovers may couple before the doorway

obstacles.note: hides the loading area from the start zone and from overhead camera west
occludes the docking face in the assembly zone from the south
elevated; blocks overhead views of part of the assembly zone, does not block driving

mission_default: locate the payload (unknown position inside the loading area), pick it up, bring it through the doorway to the delivery zone

outcomes.delivered: payload centre inside the delivery zone, at rest, supported, within the deadline
outcomes.dropped: payload contacts the floor outside the loading area or delivery zone
outcomes.stuck: no progress for 60 s or deadline reached
outcomes.unsafe: a load-bearing connection released without verified support, or a collision above the contact threshold
